answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 20926 Country: Pakistan Title: What should be the lenght & width of the sutrah? Question: Assalam Alaikum What should be the lenght & width of the sutrah? Answer ID: 20926 Posted on: May 28, 2024 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 553/447/B=1431) The least length of sutra should be two spans and the width similar to the thickness of the smallest finger of the hand. ---------------------- For more, see: https://darulifta-deoband.com/home/ur/salah-prayer/168083 ---------------------- Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
